summary: Full E2E happy-path proof for GitHub App connect + Add Project wizard on THIS preview pod. Logged in as test@aurem.dev (founder), opened /projects, clicked Add Project, wizard Step 1 rendered real repo picker instantly (no 'Checking your GitHub connection...' spinner, no 'Connection didn't finish' error) fed by useGitHubConnectStatus polling /api/aurem-dev/github/app/status. All 8 expected polarisbuiltinc-wq repos rendered as data-testid=add-wizard-repo-{full_name} buttons (Aurem, claude-ai-mcp, developer-dashboard-design, ora-grounding, auremdev-update, aurem-rollback-testbed, aurem-push-proof-disposable, Aurem-1). Clicked polarisbuiltinc-wq/Aurem-1 -> instantly advanced to wizard-step-2 with 'Access to polarisbuiltinc-wq/Aurem-1 verified · Connected via GitHub App · @polarisbuiltinc-wq' and pre-filled project name 'Aurem-1'. Clicked Save & Open Chat -> navigated to /dashboard within ~2s, toast 'Connected polarisbuiltinc-wq/Aurem-1 — opening chat...' shown, top nav updated to 'polarisbuiltinc-wq/Aurem-1 › main', ORA chat greeting rendered, scope pill 'Aurem-1 · polarisbuiltinc-wq/Aurem-1@main' shown. Backend /api/aurem-dev/github/app/status confirmed installation_active:true, state:connected, 8 repos — the exact endpoint the wizard polls is healthy and NOT stuck. Founder's reported 'Connection didn't finish' issue is NOT reproducible on this preview pod; the flow works end-to-end as designed. Consistent with prior finding that the bug is production (auremcto.com) specific — likely GitHub-App-config mismatch on prod, not a code defect on this pod.

minor.issue: Returned empty projects array immediately post-save even though the new project persisted (chat loaded it correctly, top bar shows it). Likely a tier/scope filter or eventual-consistency read; not blocking wizard flow but worth a look.

critical_code_review_comments: GitHub App connect flow code on this preview pod is sound and behaves as spec'd — no code-level fix required here. If the founder is still seeing the stuck state on production (auremcto.com), investigation should focus on: (a) the GitHub App's Callback/Setup URL configured under github.com/settings/apps/... pointing to the correct prod host, (b) the GITHUB_APP_* env vars on prod matching the App's actual client_id/private_key/webhook_secret, (c) prod DB actually receiving the /api/aurem-dev/github/app/callback hit (currently zero DB entries for RrootsBeauty in preview which is expected — need to confirm on prod pod).

rca of the issue: Founder-reported 'Connection didn't finish — please try again' cannot be reproduced on this preview pod. Root cause is environment-specific to production (auremcto.com): the founder's GitHub install callback likely never reached the prod backend (or reached a stale deployment), OR the prod GitHub App is configured with a Callback URL pointing to a different host than the current prod pod. This preview pod's callback code path (verified via curl in a prior round) and the full UI flow (verified in this round) both work correctly end-to-end. Mitigation for prod: (a) verify GitHub App Setup URL / Callback URL in github.com/settings/apps/ points to the current auremcto.com prod host, (b) inspect prod backend logs around the founder's recording timestamp for any /api/aurem-dev/github/app/callback GET, (c) confirm GITHUB_APP_ID / private key / webhook secret env vars on prod match the actual App.
